title: Shirley D. Christensen
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young man
Married Geniel Johnson 1962, Manti Utah Temple; seven children
Branch President, High Councilor, Bishop, Regional Welfare Agent, Counselor to Stake President, Temple Ordinance Worker
President of the Argentina Resistencia Mission, 1999-2002
Wife, Geniel Johnson Christensen, dies October 2005
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
